description_en: Resets the consumption offset of a specified group ID to a specified timestamp
description_zh: 重置指定的Group ID的消费位点到指定时间戳
kebab_example: aliyun ons ons-consumer-reset-offset --group-id GID_test_consumer_id --topic test-mq-topic --type 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: OnsConsumerResetOffset

parameters.help_en: The ID of the consumer group
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The topic for which the consumption offset is reset
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en:
The message clearing type. Valid values:

0: clears all messages. When the consumer group consumes messages under this topic, it skips all currently accumulated (unconsumed) messages and starts consuming from the latest message sent after this point.
 
 This clearing method is invalid for messages for which the program returns "reconsumeLater", that is, messages that go through the retry process.
1: clears messages to a specified time. Specify a point in time. Only messages sent after this point in time are consumed.
 
 The start and end times in the optional time range are respectively the production time of the earliest and latest messages stored in the topic. You cannot select a point in time beyond the optional time range
parameters.help_zh:
消息清理类型。取值说明如下：

0：清除所有消息。该Group ID在消费该Topic下的消息时会跳过当前堆积（未被消费）的所有消息，从这之后发送的最新消息开始消费。
 
 对于程序返回"reconsumeLater"，即走重试流程的这部分消息来说，清除无效。
1：清理到指定时间。请指定一个时间点，这个时间点之后发送的消息才会被消费。
 
 可选时间范围中的起始和终止时间分别是该Topic中储存的最早的和最晚的一条消息的生产时间。不能选择超过可选时间范围的时间点
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The timestamp to which the consumption offset is reset. This parameter takes effect only when Type is set to 1. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 重置位点到指定的时间戳，仅在Type为1时生效。单位：毫秒
parameters.name: reset_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance to which the group ID to be queried belongs
parameters.help_zh: 需查询的Group ID所对应的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. This is a common parameter. Each request has a unique ID that can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
